When that document carries a result\n2720\t    row with status `rejected`, the kernel has already appended the row: the\n2721\t    claim is terminal (`_assert_lifecycle_mutation_allowed`) and the request\n2722\t    derives REJECTED (`derive_request_state`, results dominate). Anything else\n2723\t    on a non-zero exit is a refusal before the row and leaves the claim live.\n2724\t    \"\"\"\n2725\t    text = submit_stdout or \"\"\n2726\t    start = text.find(\"{\")\n2727\t    if start < 0:\n2728\t        return False\n2729\t    try:\n2730\t        payload = json.loads(text[start:])\n2731\t    except ValueError:\n2732\t        return False\n2733\t    row = payload.get(\"row\") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None\n2734\t    return (isinstance(payload, dict) and payload.get(\"status\") == \"rejected\"\n2735\t            and isinstance(row, dict) and row.get(\"row_type\") == \"result\" and row.get(\"status\") == \"rejected\")\n2736\t\n2737\t\n2738\tdef _held_request_state(request_id: str, base_dir: Path) -> str | None:\n2739\t    \"\"\"The lease guard's question to the kernel: what state is the request in?\n2740\t\n2741\t    None when the kernel has no such request — nothing can be held, so the\n2742\t    guard has nothing to hand back (the mocked executor fixtures claim a\n2743\t    request that was never minted). `derive_request_state` refuses an\n2744\t    unknown id, and a refusal the guard could not tell from an unreadable\n2745\t    ledger would make it release on every mocked run.\n2746\t    \"\"\"\n2747\t    from aria_kernel.agent_invocations import list_agent_invocation_requests\n2748\t\n2749\t    if not list_agent_invocation_requests(request_id=request_id, base_dir=base_dir):\n2750\t        return None\n2751\t    return _derive_request_state(request_id=request_id, base_dir=base_dir)\n2752\t\n2753\t\n2754\tdef _rejected_only_for_verification_unavailable(submit_stdout: str) -> bool:\n2755\t    \"\"\"Did the kernel reject the submission SOLELY because it could not verify?\n2756\t\n2757\t    The kernel CLI prints its verdict as JSON on stdout: on a rejection,\n2758\t    ``reasons`` (prose, for the ledger and the operator) and\n2759\t    ``rejection_codes`` (one machine code per reason). The judge's own\n    # verdict.model self-report remains in the payload as data, but the\n    # kernel's anchor distinct-model count must not trust a string the\n    # judged agent wrote about itself — a misreported model silently\n    # satisfies or violates ANCHOR_MIN_DISTINCT_MODELS, which is exactly\n    # the guarantee that field exists to provide.\n    # ARIA-MEDIUM-171 — the route's word, never the agent's: a named model\n    # overwrites whatever the agent wrote under the key, and a route that\n    # named nothing REMOVES the key rather than leaving the agent's spelling\n    # in place (ORPHAN-HIGH-781 pinned \"no stale stamp\" for the absent case).\n    if dispatch_model:\n        details[\"agent_dispatch_model\"] = dispatch_model\n    else:\n        details.pop(\"agent_dispatch_model\", None)\n    details[\"agent_confidence_source\"] = confidence_source\n    details.setdefault(\"agent_text\", _safe_agent_text_excerpt(agent_text))\n    if usage is None:\n        usage = extract_usage(parse_claude_jsonl(raw_stdout))\n    if usage is not None:\n        details.setdefault(\"claude_cli_usage\", usage)\n    envelope[\"details\"] = details\n\n    return envelope\n\n\ndef _rejected_result_recorded(submit_stdout: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True when the submit step's answer is a kernel-recorded REJECTED result row.\n\n    `aria_kernel agent submit-result` prints its result document on stdout and\n    exits 1 for anything but `accepted`. When that document carries a result\n    row with status `rejected`, the kernel has already appended the row: the\n    claim is terminal (`_assert_lifecycle_mutation_allowed`) and the request\n    derives REJECTED (`derive_request_state`, results dominate). Anything else\n    on a non-zero exit is a refusal before the row and leaves the claim live.\n    \"\"\"\n    text = submit_stdout or \"\"\n    start = text.find(\"{\")\n    if start < 0:\n        return False\n    try:\n        payload = json.loads(text[start:])\n    except ValueError:\n        return False\n    row = payload.get(\"row\") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None\n    return (isinstance(payload, dict) and payload.get(\"status\") == \"rejected\"\n            and isinstance(row, dict) and row.get(\"row_type\") == \"result\" and row.get(\"status\") == \"rejected\")\n\n\ndef _held_request_state(request_id: str, base_dir: Path) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The lease guard's question to the kernel: what state is the request in?\n\n    None when the kernel has no such request — nothing can be held, so the\n    guard has nothing to hand back (the mocked executor fixtures claim a\n    request that was never minted). `derive_request_state` refuses an\n    unknown id, and a refusal the guard could not tell from an unreadable\n    ledger would make it release on every mocked run.\n    \"\"\"\n    from aria_kernel.agent_invocations import list_agent_invocation_requests\n\n    if not list_agent_invocation_requests(request_id=request_id, base_dir=base_dir):\n        return None\n    return _derive_request_state(request_id=request_id, base_dir=base_dir)\n\n\ndef _rejected_only_for_verification_unavailable(submit_stdout: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Did the kernel reject the submission SOLELY because it could not verify?\n\n    The kernel CLI prints its verdict as JSON on stdout: on a rejection,\n    ``reasons`` (prose, for the ledger and the operator) and\n    ``rejection_codes`` (one machine code per reason). {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01ALjZqWKdNwmBLzBc15rJdq","type":"tool_result","content":"241\tdef record_judge_verdict_from_response(\n242\t    *,\n243\t    request: dict[str, Any],\n244\t    response: dict[str, Any],\n245\t    base_dir: str | Path | None = None,\n246\t) -> dict[str, Any] | None:\n247\t    \"\"\"Translate an ACCEPTED judge response into an ai_judge feedback row.\n248\t\n249\t    Returns the persisted row, or None when the envelope role is not a\n250\t    judge role (the bridge is a no-op for non-judge submissions).\n251\t\n252\t    Raises GovernanceError when the response is missing the data the\n253\t    consensus engine requires (tool_id / run_id / finding_id come from\n254\t    the request envelope's optional fields; verdict + severity from\n255\t    the response.details).\n256\t    \"\"\"\n257\t    role = response.get(\"role\")\n258\t    if not is_judge_role(role):\n259\t        return None\n260\t\n261\t    # Y5 (ORPHAN-706) — one contract, two consumers: the executor's\n262\t    # pre-submit gate checks exactly this list and releases instead of\n263\t    # sealing an unfoldable accepted result; the bridge raises on it so a\n264\t    # row that somehow slipped past still fails loudly, never half-folds.\n265\t    contract_errors = validate_judge_response(request=request, response=response)\n266\t    if contract_errors:\n267\t        raise GovernanceError(\n268\t            \"judge bridge contract violation: \" + \"; \".join(contract_errors)\n269\t        )\n270\t\n271\t    details = response.get(\"details\") or {}\n272\t    if not isinstance(details, dict):\n273\t        details = {}\n274\t\n275\t    # ORPHAN-CRITICAL-735 — the arbiter's legitimate non-verdict outcome\n276\t    # folds through the SAME producer, ledger and idempotent escalation_id\n277\t    # as the deterministic engine, so one sweep drains both lanes into one\n278\t    # HUMAN_REQUIRED record. It is NOT a feedback verdict: an uncertain\n279\t    # arbitration must never write an ai_judge row.\n280\t    if role == \"consensus_arbitration\":\n281\t        arb_block = _verdict_field(details)\n282\t        arb_reason = arb_block.get(\"uncertainty_reason\")\n283\t        if arb_block.get(\"verdict\") is None and arb_reason in CONSENSUS_UNCERTAINTY_REASONS:\n284\t            from .feedback_store import record_consensus_uncertainty\n285\t\n286\t            row = record_consensus_uncertainty(\n287\t                tool_id=str(request.get(\"tool_id\") or arb_block.get(\"tool_id\") or \"\"),\n288\t                run_id=str(request.get(\"run_id\") or arb_block.get(\"run_id\") or \"\"),\n289\t                finding_id=str(request.get(\"finding_id\") or arb_block.get(\"finding_id\") or \"\"),\n290\t                group_id=str(request.get(\"judgment_group_id\") or arb_block.get(\"group_id\") or \"\"),\n291\t                reason=str(arb_reason),\n292\t                cycle_id=request.get(\"cycle_id\"),\n293\t                base_dir=base_dir,\n294\t            )\n295\t            return {\"kind\": \"consensus_uncertainty\", **row}\n296\t    verdict_block = _verdict_field(details)\n297\t\n298\t    tool_id = request.get(\"tool_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"tool_id\")\n299\t    run_id = request.get(\"run_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"run_id\")\n300\t    finding_id = request.get(\"finding_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"finding_id\")\n301\t    if not (tool_id and run_id and finding_id):\n302\t        raise GovernanceError(\n303\t            \"judge bridge requires tool_id, run_id, finding_id in request or response.details.verdict; \"\n304\t            f\"got tool_id={tool_id!r}, run_id={run_id!r}, finding_id={finding_id!r}\"\n305\t        )\n306\t\n307\t    # Typed-judgment plan — a typed block folds through the typed parser:\n308\t    # the verdict is its value, the confidence its top-label probability,\n309\t    # the refs the request's own strings materialized from its indices.\n310\t    confidence_source, _source_error = stamped_confidence_source(details)\n311\t    typed = typed_verdict_block(verdict_block)\n312\t    typed_answer: TypedAnswer | None = None\n313\t    if typed is not None:\n314\t        question, outcome = parse_typed_verdict(request, typed)\n315\t        if isinstance(outcome, ParseFailure):\n316\t            raise GovernanceError(f\"judge bridge typed verdict refused: {outcome.reason_code}: {outcome.detail}\")\n317\t        typed_answer = outcome\n318\t        verdict_block = {\n319\t            **verdict_block,\n320\t            \"verdict\": typed_answer.value,\n321\t            \"confidence\": typed_answer.confidence,\n322\t            \"rationale\": typed_answer.rationale,\n323\t            \"evidence_refs\": materialize_evidence_refs(question, typed_answer),\n324\t        }\n325\t\n326\t    verdict = verdict_block.get(\"verdict\")\n327\t    if verdict not in FEEDBACK_VERDICTS:\n328\t        raise GovernanceError(\n329\t            f\"judge bridge expected verdict in {FEEDBACK_VERDICTS}, got {verdict!r}\"\n330\t        )\n331\t    severity = _coerce_severity(verdict_block.get(\"severity\") or details.get(\"severity\"))\n332\t    # Normalize without rejecting.\"\"\"\n65\t    if not isinstance(value, str):\n66\t        return fallback\n67\t    normalized = value.strip().lower()\n68\t    if normalized in FEEDBACK_SEVERITIES:\n69\t        return normalized\n70\t    if normalized == \"informational\":\n71\t        return \"low\"\n72\t    return fallback\n73\t\n74\t\n75\tdef _verdict_field(details: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n76\t    \"\"\"The judge .md prompts shape verdicts under details.verdict (evidence,\n77\t    adversarial) or details.consensus (arbiter). refs and pinned excerpts are\n121\t    the request's own, so an index resolves to the request's ref and a quote\n122\t    is checked against the excerpt the mint pinned.\n123\t    \"\"\"\n124\t    refs = [str(ref) for ref in (request.get(\"evidence_refs\") or []) if isinstance(ref, str) and ref.strip()]\n125\t    excerpts = request.get(\"evidence_excerpts\")\n126\t    return ChoiceQuestion(\n127\t        question_id=str(request.get(\"request_id\") or \"request\"),\n128\t        prompt=str(request.get(\"suggested_prompt\") or \"judge the finding\"),\n129\t        options=tuple(FEEDBACK_VERDICTS),\n130\t        evidence_refs=tuple(refs),\n131\t        evidence_excerpts=tuple(excerpts) if isinstance(excerpts, list) else None,\n132\t    )\n133\t\n134\t\n135\tdef parse_typed_verdict(\n136\t    request: dict[str, Any], verdict_block: dict[str, Any],\n137\t) -> tuple[ChoiceQuestion, TypedAnswer | ParseFailure]:\n138\t    \"\"\"Parse a typed block against the request with the typed-judgment parser.\"\"\"\n139\t    question = _typed_question_for_request(request)\n140\t    payload = {**verdict_block, \"question_id\": question.question_id, \"primitive\": \"choice\"}\n141\t    return question, parse_single_answer(question, payload)\n142\t\n143\t\n144\tdef stamped_confidence_source(details: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str | None]:\n145\t    \"\"\"The route's stamp for where the confidence came from, and why it is refused.\n146\t\n147\t    Returns ``(source, error)``. The override is only\n    # honoured when submit_claim_result PROVED it descends from the request's\n    # base (fail-closed there); a commit that contains the base's tree plus\n    # the agent's proven work is a strictly stronger anchor than the base.\n    override = request.get(\"evidence_target_sha\")\n    if isinstance(override, str) and override.strip():\n        return override.strip()\n    value = request.get(\"target_sha\") or request.get(\"base_commit_sha\") or request.get(\"pinned_commit_sha\")\n    return str(value).strip() if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() else None\n\n\ndef _snapshot_target_sha(snapshot: dict[str, Any] | None) -> str | None:\n    if not isinstance(snapshot, dict):\n        return None\n    value = snapshot.get(\"target_sha\") or snapshot.get(\"base_commit_sha\") or snapshot.get(\"pinned_commit_sha\")\n    return str(value).strip() if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() else None\n\n\ndef _snapshot_requires_repo_verified(snapshot: dict[str, Any] | None) -> bool:\n    if not isinstance(snapshot, dict):\n        return False\n    if snapshot.get(\"require_repo_verified_evidence\") is True:\n        return True","numLines":110,"startLine":640,"totalLines":774}}}
